learning_outcomes.text: Knows simple rules related to basic materials science based on undergraduate level qualifications
Distinguishes atomic relationships affecting material properties and to clarify material density, conductivity, and shaping properties.
Defines and analyzes problems in the field of work and produce solutions based on scientific methods.
Carry out a study requiring expertise in the field in almost every field where materials are used.
Evaluates and renews the expert level knowledge and skills acquired in the field of applied materials.
Knows simple rules related to basic materials science based on undergraduate level qualifications.
